newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to go up to 4,890, may peer 4,900.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to go up to 4,890, may peer 4,900.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index looks set to reach 4,890 and may peer above 4,900 on Friday, technical analysts said.
Bank shares will again help push the market up although pharmaceuticals may not be so lively, they added.
The market had a difficult time on Thursday when hesitancy crept in after the FTSE failed close above 4,900 earlier in the week.
But investor confidence should revive today and the market should discover it has the capability to spring higher.
By 0720 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 10.7 at 4,873.6.

Converging trendlines connecting the FTSE's intra-day highs and lows since July 16 shows the market's freedom of movement narrowing but, with the medium-term uptrend still in place, analysts expect the market to make a break above the upper line.
Wednesday's fumbling motion may have spoiled its rhythm from earlier in the week when the FTSE fled higher and managed to avoid closing below 4,800.
And if it can manage to go forward today the FTSE should soon be able to recover that lost momentum, analysts said.
